verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA25968832 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318564 (2025-10-15). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 8,000 pcs at 6.11 USD, confirmed delivery 2025-11-27. Terms EXW Boise, NET30. The delivery terms text contradicts itself on who pays freight.
red_flags: Delivery terms are internally inconsistent: Incoterms EXW Boise (buyer normally arranges and pays freight, insurance and duties) and 'DDP is not agreed', yet 'Freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice'. This means extra freight, insurance and duty charges may appear on the invoice despite EXW.
No total price and no unit of measure are stated on the document.
The document has no issue date.
observations: Clean printed single-page document with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
Description wraps over three lines in the table (Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5).
